headline: AMD to acquire Fei-Fei Li's World Labs for $8.2 billion
summary: AMD is acquiring World Labs, the AI research lab co-founded by Fei-Fei Li, for approximately $8.2 billion in an all-stock deal. Li will join AMD as executive vice president and chief scientist. World Labs launched in 2024 and was valued at $1 billion within months.
